name: No hardware acceleration · software emulation from the start (example)
author: ApkStart
description: When Hypervisor Platform is off and kernel drivers cannot be installed, the emulator fails outright on hardware acceleration. This patch makes ApkStart use software emulation from the start (-accel off), saving two rounds of waiting, and switches the render backend to software to avoid GL initialization failures.

notes: Software emulation is 5-10x slower than hardware acceleration; when virtualization can be enabled, tick Virtual machine platform in Windows Features instead
